svg.title: Your Medicare sign-up window is 7 months long
svg.desc: A seven-month timeline. The three months before your 65th birthday month are the best time to sign up, because coverage starts the month you turn 65. Your birthday month and the three months after are still allowed, but coverage starts later.

text.style: font:700 30px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: Your Medicare sign-up window is 7 months long

text.style: font:400 18px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: It opens 3 months before the month you turn 65 — and when you sign up changes when coverage starts.

text.style: font:700 19px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#ffffff

svg.text: 3 months BEFORE

text.style: font:400 16px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#dbe8f5

svg.text: your birthday month

text.style: font:700 18px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#ffffff

svg.text: BIRTHDAY

text.style: font:700 18px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#ffffff

svg.text: MONTH

text.style: font:700 19px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#ffffff

svg.text: 3 months AFTER

text.style: font:400 16px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#eef2f7

svg.text: your birthday month

text.style: font:700 17px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:700 17px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: 65th

text.style: font:700 17px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:700 17px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:700 17px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:700 16px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#1f4e79

svg.text: Sign up in these 3 months

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: Coverage starts the first day of the month

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: you turn 65 — no gap, no penalty.

text.style: font:700 16px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#1f4e79

svg.text: This is the best time.

text.style: font:700 16px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: Sign up in your birthday month or after

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: Still allowed, but coverage starts the

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: first day of the NEXT month — so you can

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: be left without coverage for a while.

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: Miss all 7 months and you may pay a late-enrollment penalty for as long as you have Medicare.

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: Different rules apply if you are still working and covered by a large employer's plan.

text.style: font:400 14px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#7a8ba3

svg.text: mediprimer.org
